_comment: Set the project's Root Directory to `apps/web` in Vercel; this file is read from there.
The build command is turbo, not `next build`, for one reason: apps/web imports
@lumina/contract, which is a COMPILED package (main: ./dist/index.js) whose dist/ is
gitignored. Vercel clones the repo, so that dist does not exist. `turbo run build
--filter=@lumina/web` follows dependsOn:['^build'] and builds the contract first —
verified locally as 2 tasks, not 1. Plain `next build` fails on an unresolvable import.
Only this app deploys: Root Directory scopes the project to apps/web, and the gateway
and agent are deployed separately to Fly (see apps/*/fly.toml). Vercel additionally
skips builds when nothing this project depends on has changed.
